title: Unable to use `Color.from_rgba8` in const variable
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproduced in v4.5.dev2.official [af2c71397]
- Likely reproduceable in every version since #100825 which adds the static function

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev2 - Windows 10 (build 19044) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6117) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8700K CPU @ 3.70GHz (12 threads)

### Issue description

`Color8` is deprecated, but its replacement `Color.from_rgba8` can not be used in a const variable context:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/163886d1-8898-4622-a21f-7a2dd1dd4ff5)

If `Color8` is to be removed in a later version, its replacement should not be considered a downgrade in terms of flexibility.

I know this is an overall larger problem with const in GDScript, but it seems like certain special cases are already implemented, so this list could be expanded further to avoid compatibility problems.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a script with these contents:

```gdscript
extends Node

const GOOD = Color8(20, 40, 60)

const BAD = Color.from_rgba8(20, 40, 60)
```

Observe the error:

```
Assigned value for constant "BAD" isn't a constant expression.
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A, see script above
